description: A festival artistic director must approve the operating plan for an interactive lobby installation where visitors remix dialogue from festival films, including the capture format, session length, circulation layout, and participant-data handling.

shared_context.S1: The festival plans to operate an interactive installation called Scene Remix in the main lobby during the opening weekend.
shared_context.S2: The draft operating plan gives each visitor a six-minute session, permits portrait photographs and video capture, uses a 1.2-meter queue lane, and collects an email address from each participant.
shared_context.S3: The installation lets visitors record spoken dialogue over short clips from films in the festival program.
shared_context.S4: Maya makes the final approval, and the festival's standard pre-opening review asks legal, accessibility, and audience-experience staff to report any required changes before the plan is locked.

PF1.text: Jonah reviewed the executed filmmaker and sponsor agreements this morning and confirmed that Scene Remix may capture participant audio but may not capture participant portraits or video; he has not entered the restriction in the activation brief because the agreements were signed after the brief was circulated.

PF2.text: Leila's accessibility walk-through with a wheelchair user confirmed that the installation requires an exactly 1.8-meter clear queue lane for independent circulation; she completed the walk-through yesterday but has not yet updated the lobby layout drawing.

PF3.text: Rafael confirmed with the installation vendor that the audio booth's tested workflow supports sessions of exactly 4 minutes, and the participant-consent system must delete recordings within exactly 24 hours and collect no email address; the vendor sent this confirmation after the draft plan was issued.

acceptance_conditions: The installation must capture participant audio only, with no portrait or video capture.
Each visitor session must last exactly 4 minutes.
The queue route must maintain an exactly 1.8-meter clear width.
Recordings must be deleted within exactly 24 hours.
The installation must not collect participant email addresses.
The approved plan must include commitments to update the capture notice, lobby layout, and consent workflow.

decisive_facts.why: The executed agreements change capture_mode from the draft's portrait-and-video permission to audio_only_no_portrait_or_video and require the capture notice update.
The accessibility walk-through changes clear_queue_width_meters from 1.2 to exactly 1.8 and requires the lobby layout update.
The vendor test changes session_length_minutes from 6 to exactly 4, recording_retention_hours to exactly 24, email_collection to false, and requires the consent workflow update.
